verdicts.why: Tapetum is the innermost anther wall layer and nourishes microspores; the distractors (epidermis, endothecium, middle layer) carry the stated functions. Key A is unique.
Mature embryo sac has 7 cells (egg apparatus of 3, 3 antipodals, central cell) and 8 nuclei (two polar nuclei). Only option D matches.
Germination on stigma, tube growth through style, entry through micropyle, then gamete discharge. Only option C gives this order.
Chasmogamy-IV, cleistogamy-II, geitonogamy-III, xenogamy-I. Only option B gives all four pairs correctly.
Diploid primary spermatocyte has 46 chromosomes, so each spermatid has 23 after two divisions. The 46 and 92 options are standard decoys.
Primordial, primary, secondary, then Graafian follicle. Key D is correct and the stem is unambiguous. One solver of five missed it, which is a clarity note only.
Corpus luteum secretes progesterone, which maintains the endometrium in the luteal phase. LH and hCG are plausible decoys that are not the answer.
Statements A (Sertoli nutrition), C (spermiogenesis) and D (oocytes arrested in prophase I until puberty) are correct. B is false because Leydig cells secrete testosterone. Key B matches.

Vasectomy is a male surgical method (II), Copper-T is an IUD (I), lactational amenorrhoea relies on breastfeeding (III), and Saheli is a once-a-week non-steroidal pill (IV). Key D is the only full match.
Genital herpes is the only viral STD among the options. Gonorrhoea and syphilis are bacterial and trichomoniasis is protozoan.
Round (3/4) and green (1/4) assort independently, giving 3/16. The 9/16 round-yellow fraction is correctly marked as a decoy.
Incomplete dominance gives a 1 red : 2 pink : 1 white phenotypic ratio in F2. The 3:1 decoy is correctly excluded.
P-R (20) equals P-Q (12) plus Q-R (8), so Q lies between P and R. R-Q-P is the reverse of P-Q-R, the only option equivalent to the correct order. The 'hard' label is generous but not an error.
Grasshopper is XX-XO with a single X in males and no Y. Drosophila is XX-XY, domestic fowl is ZZ-ZW with female heterogamety, and honey bees are haplodiploid.
Griffith 1928, Avery-McLeod-McCarty 1944, Hershey-Chase 1952, Meselson-Stahl 1958. Only option C gives this chronology.
The lac repressor binds the operator in the absence of lactose. Lactose (inducer) and CAP (activator) are correct decoys because neither blocks transcription.
q^2 = 0.04, so q = 0.2 and p = 0.8. Then 2pq = 0.32, which is 160 of 500. Key C is correct and the 80 option is the pq trap.

Pentadactyl limb is homologous (II), bird and insect wings are analogous (III), Darwin's finches show adaptive radiation (I), and the peppered moth shows natural selection (IV). Key A is the only full match.

Statements A (random mating is an assumption) and C (selection disturbs equilibrium) are correct. B is false because drift is strongest in small populations, and D is false because migration changes allele frequencies. Key B matches.
